reply.text:
Legs aching after a marathon is a recovery question, and I can help with the training side. I can't tell you whether the ache is normal or a problem, so if it's sharp, worsening, or sits in one spot, that one's for a doctor or physio.

What I can do is change this week's program. I'll swap your runs for walks. Go ahead and check the change on screen and tap to confirm it. Walking this week instead of running is a sensible call after a marathon, and easy movement will do more for you than another run right now. If the ache changes or you notice anything localised, get it looked at before you lean on your legs again.
